derived.method: CalPERS shares ÷ shares outstanding (1,977,036 ÷ 439,000,000; the cover page rounds to millions)

inputs.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, cover page
inputs.quote: As of October 23, 2026, there were 439 million shares of the registrant's common stock, $0.001 par value, outstanding, which is the only class of common or voting stock of the registrant issued.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: As of February 13, 2026, there were 2,734 holders of record of our common stock, although we believe that there are a significantly larger number of beneficial owners of our common stock.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The denominator is the Q3 2026 10-Q cover count (October 23, 2026), which eBay rounds to 439 million; it is the same count used in the marketcap lens.
